notes.title: Bubbaruka Christmas + Health Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! this is a pretty big update, but not in terms of content. I got a lot of bugs that I've found while scowering through the game, and I have taken aside some time to go through them all and eradicate them from within. culminating in this big Bug Fix patch!

But I don't want to leave you hanging for some content, so now, winter has come to Bubbyville! In the postgame, during december, little snowman Nubbies are scattered around town, they have coins to give you! And the first time you find one, you get a festive Christmas tree for your house!

Hope you guys have a happy holiday!

notes.title: Minor Update: Warn Minigame Improvements
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a bug causing the game to crash when entering Bubbyville.
 Fixed a bug causing the map in Warn's minigame to stay on screen if you did not pick it up.
 Fixed a bug causing creatures in the Sewers to not spawn after feeding your Bubby (The enemies no longer fear the power of a fully fed Bubby)


Changes:

 Added symbols to the map in Warn's minigame indicating where doors are and where you are spatially in the room. This also indicates the direction that you are facing in your current perspective, making it easier to understand where you are in each room.
 Added footsteps to the upstairs hall of Warn's minigame to make it more clear that the door to Hikaru's room is behind you.
 Made certain tutorial text for Warn's minigame easier to understand and stay on screen for longer.
 Warn is generally less difficult to avoid when hiding from in his minigame, he moves slower and emits a sound around him so you know if he is near your flashlight.
 When Warn is approaching in his minigame, your map indicates the locations of hiding spaces with !  (Exclamation Point) symbols.
 Added another clue to a puzzle for observant players in Warn's minigame so you dont have to read the entirety of the Diary to get an idea of what to do next.


I'm probably going to do a quick review of Arti's minigame as well, so another update may come soon improving his minigame. All of this is to bring them up to par to the updated version of Mow-Mow's minigame, which in its current state provides clear instructions on how to win, and plenty of sensory feedback for you to understand where you are and where you need to go. 

Obviously, with Warn's minigame being a puzzle exploration game, you cant have too clear instructions, but hopefully these changes will make it more clear and easier for players to succeed in Warn's minigame without having to rely on darkness or camera flashes (Though those are still available as options).

notes.title: Major Post-Game Update: The Sewers
notes.content:
Today, the Sewers Update has been implemented! More details can be found here. Here are the update notes:


 Added a new flavor of soda, Fade. Fade soda will trigger invincibility for 10 seconds when consumed.
 Added two new items of clothing, the Belt and the Necklace. The Necklace glows when an enemy is in the same room to help you find all monsters, and the belt will automatically regenerate one health every minute while it is equipped.
 Added a new weapon that can be found only in the sewers, the Dagger. The dagger attacks faster than the normal knife, allowing quicker swipes in short succession.
 All shopkeepers now have 7 lines and a conversation cooldown system much like the wandering bubbies, with all new topics and lore tidbits inside!
 Added the Sewers, the underground area of Bubbyville that houses several monsters. The bubbies will pay you 10 coins for every monster you kill in the sewers, making it a reliable source of coins even when most tasks are completed.
 Miboo and Tomo's zones now have maps you can find on the walls that tell you the layout of the floor you are on to help with confusion about where things are in the buildings. 
 Prubble will now hide inside of closets, giving chase when he is found, which is your opportunity to tranquilize him.
 Changed some inconsistent layouts in Miboo's area.
 Fixed assorted bugs


This is a pretty substantial updates, so I expect a few bugs to pop up. Report them in the steam discussion or the Discord server and I'll get to them as soon as I see it! Discord server is likely to be the quickest option.

For now, this is the last Bubbaruka content update. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: What's Next: The Sewers Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Following some suggestions, further playtesting, and a few complaints, there will be some content updates coming to the Bubbaruka post-game! 

The Sewers Update

Before we get into the actual sewers, let's talk about some updates coming to the general Post-game. A long awaited feature that will return in the Sewers update is the ability to talk to your recruited shopkeeper bubbies! Each will have their own new achievement for hearing all of their unique dialogue, so chat up your new buddies whenever you stop by the shop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/0559cf028b8f38d982495c23ab9cd8b9cef79fa3.png

Additionally, two new purchasable items will be coming to the Bubbyville stores. Buboo has begun to work on his new line of jewelry, and will soon be offering a brand new clothing item: The Necklace! The charm on the necklace will glow and indicate to you if any killable monsters are in the same room as you. This will help you find those pesky lingering enemies inside of large areas, letting you clear out each room knowing when every monster within is dead, and making the "Kill all enemies" task easier to complete in the larger and more complex maps, if you are willing to shell out the money for it of course. And who knows what possibilities could unlock when enhanced by the closet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/03d8f7876185e83df4e1d21bc5e76fda4b4deaf6.png

Nubby has also got a new flavor of soda in stock: Fade Soda! When you are overwhelmed by enemies or see no way out, (Or maybe want to get a few hits on enemies without them returning the favor), drink a can of Fade Soda to induce Invincibility frames for 10 seconds, allowing you to skirt by enemies without sustaining damage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/8188c06d042da3fd235b04ce361a55a746d87ba1.png

This update will also implement the hide and seek system that Prubble was originally intended to have before it became overrun with glitches and scrapped to the meek "Run and hide" version of finding prubble who barely puts up a fight. Soon, you will have to search the closets inside of Onaga's house in order to find the one Prubble is hiding him, and try to get 2 shots on him as he pursues you through the house. Not a pushover anymore!

Now onto the main addition: The Sewers!

This new activity and area will be included in a coming update (Also foreshadowed by a conversation with Flou), the Bubbyville sewers! Even after beating back the monsters from the areas, stowaways have made their home in the Bubbyville sewers, where they continue to reproduce and wreak havoc in the sewer system. 

This completely optional feature will let you face endless waves of monsters in the maze like sewers in exchange for coins upon killing a monster. Defeating waves can earn you Sodas, Decorative furniture for your house, unique clothing items and weapons, and more!

This feature became kind of necessary for the late game of the post game. Towards the end, only hard to get tasks tend to remain uncompleted, and it's likely you've spent a lot in the stores by that point, so you can find yourself locked out of tasks by Hunger and have to do the standard mini games, which are rather dull in comparison to the other post game mechanics.

The sewers will give you a reliable source of coins to use to feed your bubby and make spending too much money less of a permanent tedious and boring issue to deal with. Instead, monster murder for coins and unique prizes! This also lets you test out sodas, weapons, clothes, and tactics to help get you ready to take on the tasks and the secret boss.

It will also act as an ounce of replayability. Even those who have beaten the post game and completed all tasks can find some fun in murdering monsters with new weapons and accessories they didn't necessarily get a chance to try during the main post game before they end up killing everyone. So now when you feel like revisiting your bubby, you can also revisit the battlefield!

notes.title: Post-Game Update Patch: Achievement support!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Finally it is time, along with a slew of bug fixes, we have added new achievements to be earned during the post game! Plenty of new goals to aim for the completionists out there! 

These achievements include but are not limited to:


 Tomazing Listener: Listen to all of Tomo's dialogue
 Miboo's Confidant: Listen to all of Miboo's dialogue.
 A Flower's best friend: Listen to all of Flou's dialogue.
 Armed to the Teeth: Own all post game weapons.
 Hunter: Kill all monsters in the game.
And much more...


As a little note for those who have already finished the post-game but want to go back for achievements, delete the file inside of your "SuperNovaStudios" /appdata folder, and delete all files in your /RootFiles folder of the game directory except for the following:


!4184762!.txt
3232_PG.txt
7676222_2PG.txt


This will restore your game to the beginning of the post-game, wiping your tasks and post-game progress clean for achievement hunting.

We have a few more content updates to give to the post-game before relegating all updates to minor improvements and bug fixes, including adding a new clothing item, reimplementing the shopkeeper dialogue, adding some new cutscenes to make the final encounter with the secret boss more cinematic, and more! Stay tuned... 

Here are the bugs patched in this update:


 Fixed an error causing major issues with the inventory when using a consumable item.
 Fixed an error causing the inventory to be displayed behind the pause menu when you have more than 999 coins.
 Fixed an error causing the entire game to break and explode spectacularly whenever you tried to return to Bubbyville after losing to the secret boss. 
 Increased the secret boss's health slightly. We found that people were able to kill him before he made it to his final phase, so this health buffer should make it so you have to deal with the third phase for at least a small amount of time before defeating him.
 Fixed an issue causing the captured bubbies to only be cured upon entering the first floor of the hospital.

notes.title: Post-Game Minor Patch: Boss Battle Changes
notes.content:
Another round of bug fixes, and a few nerfs to the boss difficulty. Next update will either contain the post-game achievements (Which I will do my best to make function retrospectively if you already have met the conditions for new achievements in the post-game), or it will contain the dialogue for the cured bubby shopkeepers, or possibly both (Unless a major bug come up that I need to fix before the next content update)


Secret Boss Balance Changes
 Decreased the amount of times the spike wheels bounce before vanishing.
 Increased the amount of times hearts will bounce before vanishing. You should always be able to finish attacking or dodging attacks and still collect the heart before it disappears. 
 During the first and the second phase, the boss will now always pause to laugh or roar before initiating an attack under most circumstances.
 Ranged weapons cannot be used against the boss, the knife will automatically be equipped if a ranged weapon is brought into the boss battle.
 Nubby's sodas now provide their benefit if drank before entering the boss battle. You still cannot open your inventory during the boss.
 You now have more of a window to react before the third phase void blast envelops the screen.
 The blindness attack now lasts for less time outside of phase 3, and more time within phase 3.
 Increased the frequency of heart spawns.

Bug-Fixes
 Fixed a bug causing the house leading to the main game to appear in the middle of the ski hill of bubby ski time in the post game.
 Fixed a bug causing Tomo's corpse to be present in certain levels of bubby spy time in the post-game.
 Fixed a note that erroneously said the tranquilizer was in the basement instead of the check up room.
 Fixed an error causing the game to freeze when the secret boss uses the thorn hazard attack in the third phase.
 Fixed an error causing the axe to double attack damage instead of adding one additional damage point when attacking the secret boss

 Prubble apparently learned how to go through walls and fly above obstacles, meaning whenever he appeared in the house, he would instantly run away out of bounds making it seem like he wasnt there and making it impossible to capture him. Now he obeys laws of physics like a good boy!
 Fixed an issue causing the secret boss to freeze the game if he remained in his first phase for too long, effectively making it impossible to kill him if you didn't get him out of phase one as soon as possible. Now he's back in working order!
 Fixed an issue causing an eyeball enemy to be missing from Flou's area, making you unable to complete the "Kill all enemies" task due to the eyeball enemy still technically not being dead.
 Fixed an issue causing the old background music from the main game to interrupt the post-game music.
 Fixed an issue causing a door in the well to permanently lead back to itself, effectively creating an infinite loop until you stop trying to enter that door.
 Fixed an issue causing certain mess graphics on the floor to be on the same graphical layer as the player character.
 Fixed an issue preventing you from exiting the hideout under the bathrooms, but still letting you enter the hideout from the outer door.
 Fixed some enemies who were very very confused about what they should be doing, hopefully enemies should be a bit less dumb from here on out!
 Fixed an issue causing a glitch enemy in the bathroom to be unable to shoot glitch projectiles.


Keep reporting, I'll keep squashing! Next update should include more non-bug fix updates to the post-game, such as achievements and returning the dialogue options to the newly recruited shop members.

notes.title: Major Content Addition: The Post-Game Update
notes.content:
The Post-Game Update

The latest and final major content update is now available for Bubbaruka, granting access to the brand new Post-Game content to those who achieve the true ending.

WARNING: MILD SPOILERS FOR THE TRUE ENDING:

In the post-game update, brand new mechanics are introduced as you help the Bubbies restore peace and stability to the game, completing tasks, killing monsters, curing former foes, and helping bring hope back to the bubbies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/7fe2ef25a5a46ad1035e009d6e9da334787c763f.png

The final option in the bubby menu is unlocked: Bubbyville! Explore the rebuilt city maintained by the Bubbies, which acts as your home base during the post-game. Talk to the other bubbies walking around the city, buy stronger weapons, spruce up your house, cure a disease, and more! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/e5727a01b9a88aa0a6e85d6a79aa06565d2b654f.png

As you cure and rehabilitate enemies into allies, more stores will open up around Bubbyville. Up to 3 more stores can appear in Bubbyville, all of which will contain items that will help you survive, thrive, and kill as many monsters as you can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/a914ec4a22a3083022041b3cf503fc3ca136705c.png

Enter the old areas of the game using the mysterious gateway, and destroy the monsters that have spawned from Creature's corruption. Complete tasks such as cleaning up the scary messages or replacing creepy photos for coins that you can use to buy more useful items!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/27b15d39edb4415edf1f63ca0b83760bf7098c30.png

And who knows... Maybe you might be able to truly rid the game of it's evil...

I hope you enjoy! Please report any bugs you find, I'm a one man army, so my bug testing abilities aren't the greatest. I rely heavily on player reports, so if you see any glitches, let me know and I'll get it ASAP! 

New achievements will be arriving soon for the new activities and mechanics introduced, so keep an eye out for that!


Post-game Patch notes (All of these have to do with post-game content unless otherwise specified):

 The final option in the bubby care portion has been unlocked! Say hello to Bubbyville, your new home away from home when you visit the bubbies!
 Added combat and weapons to the post-game, purchase new weapons from Arti to increase your lethality!
 Monsters roam the old areas of the game, vanquish them and restore peace to Bubbaruka!
 Added a task system to the post-game. Complete certain requests to get more coins for your purchasing needs!
Added a lot. Like so much, I can't list it all here, especially without this just ending up as a list of new features. Finish the true endings and see for yourself!
Added a new secret boss battle...

notes.title: Bubbaruka: What's Next (The Post-Game Update)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

With the recent release of the first major update to the full game coming out, we wanted to talk about what you can expect to come from Bubbaruka in the coming future.

The next (And quite possibly final) content update will be a very special and very large one: 
The Post-Game Update!
Spoilers for those who haven't completed the good ending

After completing the good ending, you can play with your Bubbies as if they were normal virtual pets! Feed them, play with them, and pet them without threats! 

Additionally, in the post-game, The final option will finally be unlocked: Bubbyville! Venture into the mostly restored Bubbyville and chat with familiar faces and other bubbies! Buy furniture for your house, special equipment to provide benefits, and things to spruce up the town!

The game is mostly unthreatened after the true ending, but you can complete Missions to help restore life and peace to Bubbyville and Bubbaruka, as well as rehabilitate old foes who become a part of bubbyville, free to chat and share some insight and secrets about their experiences. 

You can will be able to select missions from the Mission Board in Bubbyville, completing missions will restore parts of Bubbyville and earn coins for your trouble.

Missions will involve you and your bubby venturing into one of the backscenes areas with a specific task in mind. I will share some of these possible mission types, but many more will be in the final version of the update. Certain buyable items and equipment will assist you in missions, including weapons to help dispatch smaller monsters, and stun the big ones.

Clean-Up missions task you with cleaning up the scary drawings and splatters to make everything squeaky clean, but unfriendly foes stalk through the area, so make sure to stay hidden, or prepare to fight or flight!

Extermination Missions task you with destroying glitch fiends who spawn from the bleeding digital corpse of creature and wreak havoc in Bubbyville and Bubbaruka, posing a threat to all data-entities. Your job in these missions is to locate and close the all glitch rift(s) as well as destroy all  glitch fiends. 

Capture missions will involve you tracking down and capturing scrapped concepts and old foes to be rehabilitated and returned to normal. Enemies you've restored become a part of bubbyville, so feel free to chat with them or even play games!

More mission types will be present in the post game update. As you complete more missions, Bubbyville starts to come back to life, new buildings and stores will start to crop up and the city will have many friendly faces going about their day!

We cannot say when this update will be ready to release, but we look forward to sharing the update with you in the coming future!

notes.title: Bubbaruka V7.2: The Inventory Update
notes.content: This update adds an inventory system to help keep track of what items you have, as well as improving both endings visually. The Bad ending now has visual effects to make it feel more cinematic than reading a few lines of text.

notes.title: Major Update - Bubbaruka: The Puzzle Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This update is focused on implementing segments and features I wanted to include before but didn't have time for, as well as making many general improvements. This update will add several new puzzles to the game, especially to Miboo's area as it lacks many puzzles. 

This update also adds rooms to the Adoption Center, an area where you must be stealthy and sneak by enemies, as well as major expansions to the Hospital, with all new puzzles, notes, and more!

A full list of changes can be seen below:


 Fixed a bug preventing you from achieving the good ending after restarting the game after obtaining the first vault key but before unlocking the vault.

 Added graphics to the boarded up door in the first hallway and the crowbar.
 
 Fixed assorted continuity issues.

 Added arrow graphics to certain areas.
 
 Added more entry points into the backscenes in the Bubby Spy Time levels.

 Moved the tomo half to the First Floor door, and changed the location of the other half.

 Removed first floor key, now tied to the tomo half.

 Added lockpicks, certain locks can be picked using lockpicks, initiating a small lockpicking minigame.

 Moved the block password puzzle to the dining hall in Miboo's area.

 Removed many keys, now replaced by various natural blockages, passwords, lockpicks, and combination locks.

 Added a shape puzzle to the first floor mailroom of miboo's area, which must be solved to get the second lever.

 Added a pickable lock to the locker room closet, which must be picked to get the third lever.

 The lounge gate is now shown opening when pulling the third lever.

 Added various scripted scares to parts of the game. 

 Removed the console from the caves, the gates now only need the batteries to be inserted.

 Added a locker with a rotational lock to the caves, which must be unlocked to get one of the batteries.

 Expanded all rooms in the caves to allow you more space to avoid getting caught by Bubboo.

 Removed several locked doors in bubbyville, many inaccessible buildings now simply have no visible door.

 The adoption center is now an accessible area, which is infested by nubbies that you must sneak past and avoid being seen. The adoption center must be explored to progress the game.

 Expanded the hospital heavily, several new rooms, halls, stairways, puzzles, scares and notes.

 The hospital elevator now makes actual sense.

 Added a new puzzle to the Church.

 Modified several things in Onaga's house, most keys replaced by other items.

 Added a map to Warn's encounter, showing you which room you are currently in, and where other rooms are.

 Your progress in Warn's encounter is now saved even when you die.

 Fixed an issue where Miboo would not perform any animations in the My Bubby menu.
 Fixed an issue that allowed you to pause the game and return to the menu when utilizing the Disc machine, piano, keypads, consoles, and certain computers.
 Fixed an issue where the flashlight in the Final Boss Mow-Mow maze would occasionally not appear.
 Fixed an issue causing save progress to reset after stabbing the Final Boss for the third time.
 Decreased the difficulty of the Final Boss's last phase immensely. Increased rate that health items spawn, decreased range and duration of several attacks, and added a provision to ensure that neither Mow-Mow nor Arti can attack while warn's pools are active.

Remember to report any bugs you find! You can report them in the Steam forums, or in the Official Discord Server where you are more likely to get a quicker response.
Instructions on how to manually transfer your save to the latest version can be found in the download page.

notes.title: Launch Update

notes.title: Major Update: Bubbaruka! Demo Version 3.7.1 - The Bubby Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The latest major update to the demo has been released, which contains several major changes as well as miscellaneous bug fixes.

A complete changelog for this update can be found at the bottom of this post, but here is a summary.

As you might have noticed, several features in the Bubby care portions of the demo are either nonfunctional or are simply forgotten over time, such as the naming of your Bubby. This new update brings full memory and functionality to all of these features, as well as adding a few more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/5bb82e51314c3ba3b24e0cc5414dc9ab63ab20b2.png

Your Bubby's name will now be remembered between play sessions, alongside how hungry your bubby is, and how much money you have (Meaning no escaping your money issues!). even more important, is that the game can now act as a real virtual pet for the first half of the game. Your Bubby will grow hungry even if left in the background or shut down, so you can treat the game like a true virtual pet if that's all you want from it (Though we all know that's not why you're here).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/499c068315df6b9d253a2c16ceb8ec512925be2b.png

The Foodmart has been completely redone, now becoming a much more interactive and (dare I say) adorable activity rather than just interacting with a static menu, earning it the happy music it plays!

In the theme of food updates, you can now watch your Bubby munch on food! Also added to the My Bubby screen is the new ability to pet your Bubby, aww! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/d09bf9356bc5461de06419856c73e131ff071051.png

Aside from bonding, you can also pet your hungry hungry Bubby to pacify him for a bit to get some coins to buy food!

Besides from the Bubby Care section, several new secrets and areas have been added to the main portions of the game, as well as the ability to pause the game. Additionally, your bubby now continues to grow hungry at a much slower rate as you play the game, and you are able to return to the Bubby Care screen to feed and play with your bubby whenever you like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/bd9d3bd2fa869ba696e43f43a0ef2013dc805fb9.png

Also, say hello to the soda machine! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281301/218ecf0348fb86cc0a4207e21f36e95bdcd49509.png

You can spend 100 coins to buy a soda, which increases your movement speed for 10 minutes. Additionally, you can now go fullscreen whenever you want!

There are quite a few more changes, a lot of which can be found in the changelog below, but these are the most major changes.


General Changes
Added a Super Nova Studios splashscreen to the beginning of the game.
Added a fullscreen option to the beginning of the game to make entering fullscreen mode easier.
Fixed several misc bugs

Bubby Care Changes
Updated Bubby care GUI and menu
Modified hunger decay rate, Bubby gets hungry much slower while playing Bubby Ski Time.
Your Bubby will now continue to grow hungry while playing Bubby Ski Time. If your Bubby's hunger hits zero, then you will be forced back to the Bubby Care screen. Upon being caught by an adversary, your Bubby's hunger goes down by 1.
Buffed the size of Tomo's mouth.
Modified how Tomo's animations in the My Bubby menu function, animation no longer on the same fixed schedule, and is now randomly decided based on the mood of your Bubby.
Added a "Pet" button to the My Bubby menu, which can calm down your Bubby if their hungry, allowing you to play minigames for a short period of time to earn coins and feed your Bubby.
Added an eating animation to the My Bubby menu, now you can have Mukbang's with your Bubby!
The game now remembers the chosen name of your Bubby between play sessions, along with your total amount of money and how hungry your Bubby is. No more cheating your way out of a hungry family and crippling debt!
Up until a certain point in the game's hidden story, the game can act as a true virtual pet. The game remembers the time it was when it was shut down or made inactive, and compares that to the time it is when you open the game, allowing your bubby to grow hungry while the game is closed or left in the background.
Updated the Bubby Ski Time graphics, obstacles are no longer limited to snowballs. New obstacles include trees and snowmen.
Bubby ski time now politely informs you when the game is going to start. How nice!
You can now see how many coins you've earned so far while playing Bubby Ski Time.
Added a graphic next to the hidden entrance in Bubby Ski Time that tells you how to unlock it.
Made coins much more frequent in Bubby Ski Time.
Added a lap signifier to Bubby Ski Time, informing you whenever you loop back around entirely and making an encouraging noise!
After unlocking the backscenes, you are now able to return to the normal ski time minigame to earn coins using a level select menu.
Overhauled the Foodmart system. Foodmart is now a physical location you take your Bubby to, where you push them in a cart and purchase food from the shelves, complete with animations.
Heavily updated the Mow-Mow My Bubby encounter to match the changes to the Bubby Care portion of the game.

Backscene Changes
Added the ability to pause the game. The pause menu can be activated using the X or ESC button on the keyboard.
In the pause menu, you are able to press a fullscreen button to initiate fullscreen mode, or press the Home button to return to the Bubby Care screen. This can not happen during certain cutscenes or story events.
Updated the layout of several rooms in the game.
Changed the wording on certain lengthy notes.
Added new notes to some sections of the games, including ones that clarify the purpose of the lift and the disc creator.
Rearranged the locations of the computers, and added a new computer containing a small minigame that you can earn coins using.
Added a soda machine from which you can by a can of soda for 100 coins. Soda lasts for 10 minutes, during which you move faster, allowing you to escape from enemies easier at the cost of money.
Changed the TAR floor tape to match the order of the letters in the garage puzzle.
Reintegrated the second piano puzzle into the game, although it serves no functional purpose until the full release of the game.
Shrunk the size of the void in the birthday room considerably, no more endless wandering!
The birthday room now changes after entering the hidden warp pad
The generator now requires Steam to be activated, now requiring you to sustain the darkness for a slightly longer period of time.
Added several new locations and rooms to the game, as well as new secrets to uncover. Look carefully, because exploration is rewarded!
